preconditions.description: The number of rows r must be between 1 and 500.
The number of columns c must be between 1 and 500.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if r == 1 and c == 1 else any(all(1 <= a[i][j] <= 10**9 for j in range(c)) for i in range(r))
postconditions.description: If r and c are both 1, output 0; otherwise, output a diverse matrix with all elements between 1 and 10^9.
All GCDs in the array b must be pairwise distinct.
The maximum value in the array b must be minimized.
